**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve file-level issue identity through the annotation adapter**

For file-level SonarQube issues, copying `error.line` cannot preserve the intended `null` location: `github.annotations()` always supplies a numeric `start_line`, enforced by `annotationSchema` and `CheckAnnotation`. Consequently, the production path never reaches `around(text, null)`, despite the unit tests passing hand-built null lines. File-level issues are instead presented to the model as line-specific and receive the wrong context window rather than the first 40 lines. Preserve an explicit file-level marker in the annotation contract and normalize it before constructing the issue.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Split SonarQube annotations before applying the context size limit**

When the annotations exceed 16 KiB in aggregate, `readCheckContext()` discards annotations before this code splits them into findings. Reproducing with ten annotated issues whose messages are 2,000 characters long yields only eight findings, so two annotated issues never receive a verdict. If the total notice is also discarded, the fallback total hides the omission entirely. Read the complete annotations for this check before splitting, and apply any model-context limit separately to each issue instead of using the already-truncated generic check context.
